description: Submit a validated social draft (draftId) or blog article (articleId) to the workspace’s internal approval queue with an optional note for reviewers, instead of publishing directly. Nothing goes live until an admin or owner approves it.

articleId.description: Article id from articles_list or articles_save to submit for blog publishing approval. Send either draftId or articleId.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

draftId.description: Validated social draft id from drafts_list or drafts_create to submit for approval. Send either draftId or articleId.

mode.description: Action to run automatically once approved: publish, schedule or queue (queue is for social drafts only). Defaults to publish.

note.description: Optional context note for the reviewer, up to 500 characters.

scheduledAt.description: Future UTC ISO timestamp when mode is schedule (social schedule time or blog publishAt).

version.description: Expected draft or article version as last read. Refused if it changed.

name: approvals_submit
title: Submit a draft for approval
